subject.title: [Bug]: Matrix inbound image leaves agent turn unresolved; Matrix send queue hits fetch failed, then gateway reloads after ~60s

question: Should #85620 stay open for live Matrix/Tuwunel reproduction instead of being closed as stale or covered by the related Matrix media fixes?
rationale: The related fixes cover authenticated media and media-path exposure, but the reported outbound send queue failure plus active-turn and reload behavior is not proven fixed on current main.

options.title: Keep open for live repro
options.body: Keep the issue open until a current-main Matrix/Tuwunel encrypted-room run proves the exact failure path or a focused fix.

options.title: Close as covered by media fixes
options.body: Close only if maintainers accept authenticated-media and media-path fixes as sufficient despite no proof for the outbound `fetch failed` and reload path.

options.title: Close as stale
options.body: Let stale closure proceed and require a new issue if the reporter can reproduce again with fresh logs.

recommendation.title: Keep open for live repro
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open until a current-main Matrix/Tuwunel encrypted-room run proves the exact failure path or a focused fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The decisive open question is how Matrix delivery failures interact with replay and turn settlement.
